basic_info.description: Large 1,638 sq. ft. versatile live work condo with parking that faces Morris Street in a modern SoMa elevator building. This sexy, updated 3 level unit is in a convenient location and was home to artists-in-residence. Impressive with an updated kitchen and bathrooms as well as custom sliding doors to enclose the bedrooms that most loft units don't have. Its airy, light-filled layout is spacious and comfortable. It features 2 living rooms and offers the versatility for multiple office spaces and guest space. It has two decks. The open, main level includes the kitchen, living, dining, balcony, half bath, and laundry. The beautiful kitchen has ample cabinet and counter space with a breakfast bar. Upstairs has a nice bedroom suite with a full bathroom and sliding doors for both light and privacy. The lower level has its own entrance, flexible living/office space, another balcony, another bedroom, and full bathroom. Good closet space, pet-friendly, elevator, garage parking, and storage. By popular restaurants, cafes, nightlife, Whole Foods, and Trader Joe's. Minutes to downtown, Caltrain, and freeways. Near the waterfront, Mission Bay, Potrero Hill, and the Mission. Don't miss the opportunity to buy this big, turnkey condo at a great price.
